decisions.reason: The connector part and availability decision does not change the native USB D+ and D- interface requirement.
The USB-C connector selection and sourceability decision does not affect battery NTC monitoring or its J_BAT connection.
The USB-C connector selection and availability constraints do not alter battery electrical protection behavior or cutoff settings.
The USB-C connector decision is unrelated to I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
